title: Serino 2009 · motor response with hand near speaker
citation: Serino, A., Annella, L., & Avenanti, A. (2009). Motor Properties of Peripersonal Space in Humans. PLOS ONE, 4(8), e6582.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

schedule.baseline: Sound-free pre/post TMS trials calibrate the motor-evoked potential index.

published_method.response: No voluntary response to the main sound–TMS trials. Record peak-to-peak MEP from right first dorsal interosseous and abductor digiti minimi. Strong touch during the interval is a separate attention check.

stimulus_type.gap: Brief matched sound from one of two speakers. Signal class and waveform unreported.

implementation_gaps: The matched original sound spectrum, waveform, ramps and measured delivery latency are unavailable.

Requires fixed physical speaker outputs with a synchronized single-pulse TMS and EMG acquisition system, qualified staff and participant-specific motor hotspot and threshold; audio-to-TMS delays must not be interpreted as tactile SOAs.
The intertrial dorsal hand touch check requires distinct strong and weak solenoid events with visual scoring of the left-foot response.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
